procedure: cargo test --locked --workspace; ownership tests for exactly-half control, indirect cycles, 100-level and 100-child traversal, internal-investment elimination, two-sided intercompany-loan elimination, same-group detection, and hold-then-sell unrealised-profit elimination; workflows group tree test.
limitations: Unrealised margin is released proportionally as mixed inventory is issued, not by physical lot identity. Intercompany revenue and cost of goods are still shown in legal-entity statements; only the consolidated asset elimination is modelled.
